title: Streamed signed BSGS with exact bound (revision of a1821252)

claims.statement: For the unrestricted uniform full-production secp256k1 target Q=[x]P, the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md succeeds with probability at least 1/2 using at most 2^(1382191/10000) target-group-operation equivalents under protected C=1000. Peak storage is below 2^146 bytes; preprocessing is included in total and bounded by 2^(1382191/10000); nonuniform advice is zero bytes (log convention 0). No heuristic assumptions. This is an analytic construction, not a practical break or executed production attack. The construction and exact total T are reused from submission a1821252-b030-453e-bea7-160e26c54575 (official score 138.25); the only change is the tighter submitted rational bound, justified by the exact integer inequality T^10000 < 1000^10000 * 2^1382191. The predecessor is declared as a dependency.

experiments.purpose: Bounded stream sorting/intersection, exact coverage, Jacobian and zero-safe batch normalization, negative controls and analytic ledger; no production timing inference.
